asset.name: PromptComposer
asset.description: The message composer with auto-resizing entry, attachments, slash commands, mentions, model and tool context, submit, stop, retry, draft persistence, and keyboard behavior that never traps the user.

requires.reason: Auto-resizing entry, character handling, and validation treatment are shared.
Pending attachments are managed by the shared tray.
Submit is an async action control with real pending state.
Slash commands read the one registry shared with menus and the palette.

suggests.reason: Only surfaces that expose model choice need it.
Only surfaces that let the user scope tools need it.

rationale: Draft preservation is non-negotiable: losing typed input to a navigation, a failed send, or a dropped connection is the single most damaging defect a composer can have.
